entities.summary: Tcheka (b. 1973-07-20, Ribeira da Barca) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ribeira da Barca and Cape Verde. Known in the fields of cape verde, composers & musicians, africa.
